job.job_description:
Responsibilities:

SharePoint Migration (Classic to Modern)

Lead end-to-end migration from Classic SharePoint sites/pages/lists to Modern Experience.
Transform Classic pages to Modern using:
Page Transformation Tool (PnP Modernization)
PnP PowerShell
Custom migration scripts
Analyze Classic site structures, customizations, workflows, and branding to determine modernization compatibility.
Migrate:
Classic publishing sites Communication sites
Classic team sites Modern team sites
Classic lists/libs Modern lists/libs
Rebuild Classic customizations using:
SPFx
Extensions
Modern Theming
Site scripts & provisioning
Ensure content mapping, metadata consistency, IA restructuring, and delta migration planning.
Use tools like SPMT, Sharegate, Quest/Metalogix for inventory, migration, and validation.

SPFx Development

Develop SPFx Web Parts, Extensions, Command Sets, using React, TypeScript, Fluent UI.
Build solutions are integrated with Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, PnP JS.
Implement multi-environment configs, CI/CD pipelines, versioning, and deployment using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
Ensure performance optimization, accessibility compliance, and responsive UX.

Microsoft Copilot Development

Build custom Copilot Agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Create custom topics, workflows, enterprise connectors, actions, and RAG-based data access.
Design Copilot extensions for M365/Teams and integrate with business systems.
Implement data grounding, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
Work with Graph Connectors, SharePoint content, and external data sources.

Cross-Platform Solutioning

Build integrated solutions using:
SharePoint Online
Teams
Power Automate, Power Apps
Azure Functions / Logic Apps
Develop secure APIs and implement authentication using Entra ID (Azure AD).

Mandatory skill sets:

SharePoint

Deep hands-on experience in Classic to Modern modernization,
Strong knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, lists, libraries, content types, taxonomy.
Knowledge of SharePoint Classic Development

SPFx Development

React, TypeScript, Node.js, Yeoman generator.
PnP JS, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs.
Modern UX uses Fluent UI.
CI/CD for SPFx solutions.

Copilot

Custom Copilot agent development in Copilot Studio.
Prompt engineering, orchestration, secure data access.
RAG pipelines, grounding, connectors, and enterprise configuration.

Migration Tools

SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT)
Sharegate
Metalogix/Quest
PnP Modernization Framework

Preferred skill sets:

Proficiency in Agentic AI
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Years of experience required:

5 + years of experience in designing and lead the implementation, management, and optimization of Microsoft SharePoint Online, Copilot Solutions and Business Applications
